nodes.title: Note: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links and paths

The LTX-2.5 repo is gated: open [Lightricks/LTX-2.5](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5) while logged in to
Hugging Face and accept the license first. Paths are under `ComfyUI/models/`; the loaders in this workflow point at the `ltx-2.5/` subfolders below.

**diffusion_models/ltx-2.5/**
- `ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot-int8attn.safetensors` (21.5 GB): used by this workflow.
  Not a download: it is the official file below with int8 attention switched on, made with
  `python tools/add_int8_attention.py IN OUT --attention 'transformer_blocks\.\d+\.attn1$'`
- [ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors)
  (21.5 GB): the source file, and the fallback

**text_encoders/ltx-2.5/**
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) (15.4 GB)
- [gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/gemma-4/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot.safetensors)
  (5.2 GB): only for the prompt enhancer

**vae/ltx-2.5/**
- [ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors)
  (1.5 GB): first-frame encode and latent upscale
- [ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors)
  (1.5 GB): final decode
- [ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors) (0.4 GB)

**latent_upscale_models/** (no subfolder)
- [ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors) (1.0 GB)

**input/**
- [neon_cyborg_portrait.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/neon_cyborg_portrait.png): the example first frame

**Custom nodes:** only ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel (Unpinned Offload, Text Encoder BF16, VAE Chunked Conv3D).

nodes.title: Note: Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)
widgets_values:
## Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel, R9700)

- **Load Diffusion Model** uses `ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot-int8attn`: the official
  distilled int8 file with comfy-kitchen int8 attention switched on for the 48 video self-attention layers (same
  weights, only a config entry added). Stage 2 at 1280 px: 26.5 s -> 11.6 s per step.
- **Text Encoder BF16 (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)** after Load CLIP: Gemma 4 12B in bf16 instead of fp32.
- **Unpinned Offload (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)** on MODEL and CLIP: the 21.5 GB DiT and the 15 GB text encoder swap through RAM on
  every prompt change; without page-locking that swap is faster and RAM stays below ~56 GB.

Measured on the R9700 (220 W), prompt change, same seed:

| Clip | Original | **This workflow** |
|---|---|---|
| 5 s, 1280x704 (template default) | 108 s | **53 s** |
| 10 s, 704x1280 | 215 s | **97 s** |

First run after starting ComfyUI (models load from disk) takes a few minutes longer.

- **Final VAE Decode (Tiled)** uses `ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16` (Lightricks' "faster, lighter" conv VAE) through
  **VAE Chunked Conv3D (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)**, full frame, 64 frames at a time (tile 1280 / temporal 64 / overlap 16):
  decode 25 s -> 11 s (5 s clip), 51 s -> 21 s (10 s clip). Close to the default diffusion VAE (36-38 dB); skin and
  fine lines are a touch softer. For the sharpest decode, wire `ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16` back into VAE Decode (Tiled)
  with tile 512 / temporal 64 / overlap 16. Keep the Chunked Conv3D node on the conv VAE: without it the decode
  fills the card's VRAM, which hung the AMD driver in testing. For frames wider than 1280 px raise tile_size.
  The first-frame encode and the latent upscale still use the diffusion VAE.

Same shot, motion and character as the original; background details differ a little (27.8 dB).
To go back: pick `ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot` and set the two h3accel nodes to false.
The prompt enhancer (Gemma 4 E2B) is unchanged.

nodes.title: Note: Read before changing this workflow
widgets_values:
## Read before changing this workflow

1. **Keep "VAE Chunked Conv3D (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)" between the conv VAE and VAE Decode (Tiled).** Without it the conv VAE
   decode fills all 32 GB of VRAM. In testing that hung the AMD driver; ComfyUI could not be killed and the machine
   needed a reboot.
2. **Do not swap VAE Decode (Tiled) for the plain VAE Decode** on clips longer than about 5 s, for the same reason.
3. **Keep temporal_size 64 / temporal_overlap 16.** Smaller values (16 / 8) decode with a visible pulse every 8 frames.
4. **Wider than 1280 px** (for example 1920x1088): raise tile_size in VAE Decode (Tiled) to the width. Not measured;
   try a short clip first.
5. **RAM:** the text encoder (15 GB) and the model (21.5 GB) swap through system RAM; a run uses 46-53 GB of the
   64 GB, and ComfyUI keeps about 50 GB after the run so the next one starts fast. That is expected. Close other
   heavy programs. To get the RAM back, restart ComfyUI. Edit > Unload Models is not enough here: in testing it first copied
   the models still in VRAM into RAM and pushed Memory to 62 GB. If Memory stays above ~60 GB while the GPU sits
   idle, restart ComfyUI.
6. **Do not put the dev model + distilled LoRA in this workflow**: on the 64 GB test machine that
   combination runs out of RAM on 10 s clips.
7. **Tested:** 5 s at 1280x704 and 10 s at 704x1280 / 1280x704. Other sizes and lengths should work but are not
   measured. Longer or larger clips need more VRAM in stage 2.
8. The first run after starting ComfyUI is 2-4 minutes slower (models load from disk).
